title: Portrait and Room
author: Astrid Thornbury
blurb: Mara Iversen, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must return what was taken in 1974 before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
